Messages.Author: cleaves@ctron.com
Messages.Body:
Hello,

	I'm looking for Jyhad players in New Hampshire, Portsmouth area.

	Also, if all my vamps are tapped and someone calls a vote, I know the
	voting vamps still get to vote because they are considered ready, but
	can I use a reaction card on one of them? I had a reaction card in hand
	the other night that would have given me 4 votes, but all my vamps
	were tapped. Since we couldn't find anything in the rulebook, we played
	it that I couldn't use the reaction card. Luckily I had the Edge and
	was able to tie my opponent in votes :-)

	When is the Jyhad Players guide coming out? I thought it was due by
	this time?

	Are people mainly using older younger or middle-aged vamps? It seems to
	me that younger ones ( provided they have the right disciplines )
	would be best in a two player game where voting matters little, because
	they are cheap to control and quick to get into play. But I only
	received a couple young vamps, I actually have many more Justicars,
	Princes, and Primogens than anything else.

Thanks,

	Stephan

I don't recommand buying this Player's Guide.  It was more intended as a 
sourcebook for Vampire players, based on cards from Jyhad.  The examples 
of ruling written in the JPG are all messed-up and are generally more 
confusing than helpful.

If this JPG had been published by WotC instrad of WW, maybe then it would 
have been worthwhile.

And this recommandation is not based upon my own experience with the JPG, 
but rather on those of the people of the Jyhad mailing list.  There 
is a big talk about it right now and general consensus is it is not worth 
it, from a Jyhad player's point of view.
